text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer ran a fierce race in the 
Nikkei Shinshun Hai. With her party-girl 
running style and charm, she completely 
captured the fans' hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is a vital stage for the 
Mejiro family: the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Mejiro Palmer trembled with an unknown mix 
of excitement and fear.
